label: Official / announcement
definition: Tesla or Elon Musk’s official FSD v15 announcement footage, or a first-party rollout clip.

label: Reality View / visualization
definition: The new FSD v15 Reality View or other in-car visualization, including photorealistic rendering, chevrons, and camera views.

label: Parking
definition: Parking into a space, choosing a spot on screen, garage parking or leaving a garage, or an overhead parking view.

label: Highway
definition: Highway or freeway driving, including floating navigation arrows on the highway.

label: City streets
definition: City or residential street driving, including streetcars, downtown streets, or neighborhood roads.

label: Intersections
definition: Intersections and roundabouts, including turn arrows drawn at a junction.

label: Blind spot
definition: Reality View filling in or highlighting the driver’s blind spots.

label: Night / weather
definition: Night driving, seasonal lighting such as Christmas decorations, rain, or other weather.

label: Construction / obstacles
definition: Potholes, road cracks, debris, standing water, or construction in the visualization or in the drive.

label: Robotaxi / unsupervised
definition: Robotaxi, Cybercab, or unsupervised driving footage.

label: General driving
definition: FSD v15 actually driving when no more specific scene tag applies. This is the fallback tag.
